synthetic_density_mimic.forward_operator: thin buried density sheet; periodic FFT; no fault displacement or basement relief
synthetic_density_mimic.dti_reason: The synthetic sheet has no fault truth; this is a false-positive mechanism control, not a score.
synthetic_density_mimic.limitation: A finite sheet is one named non-fault mimic, not a complete model of intrabasement geology.

stop_rule: Spearman >0.90 OR >70% final dots within 3 px of any registry raster; do not submit.
hypothesis: Signed one-sided flank-offset persistence of inverted basement steps

mechanism.description: At a horizontal-gradient maximum of the inverted depth surface, sample the signed depth difference on opposite sides of the local gradient normal at 2 km and 4 km. Require the same downthrow sign at both apertures and a predeclared persistence ratio min(|delta_2km|, |delta_4km|)/(max(|delta_2km|, |delta_4km|)+epsilon) >= 0.60. Emit a 3-pixel ribbon around surviving step crests; thin to 40,000 positive pixels with 3-pixel minimum separation.

inversion_prior.stabilizer: W(k)=1/(1+(k/kc)^2), Oldenburg/Wiener low-pass; filter_order=2, kc_scale=1.0, kc=1/(2*z0); first Parker-Oldenburg slab iterate only
inversion_prior.calibration_status: uncalibrated; fixed before holdout, not fitted against band 15, GP-1012, or labels

mechanism.named_non_fault_mimic: A finite-width intrabasement mafic/granitic density body or intrusive contact can create a gravity edge without any fault. Its paired opposite-polarity edges should lose same-sign flank contrast as the sampling aperture spans the body; the control will include a synthetic buried density sheet with no basement displacement.
mechanism.band15_policy: Forbidden: neither calibration nor prediction feature.

submission.download_permission: NO_CANDIDATE_ARTIFACT; no TIF was written after the final-dot gate stopped the run.
submission.submit_recommendation: NOT_RECOMMENDED: final-dot uniqueness threshold failed and the frozen primary did not beat the unfiltered HGM control on paired HOLDOUT-DTI.

verdict_reasons: Final-dot uniqueness gate failed against the refreshed accessible registry: 70 registry rasters were duplicate-flagged at the >0.70 overlap threshold; worst 3 px dot overlap was 1.0 against 17GEMSDOE:docs/downloads/17GEMSDOE_E-proba-multiscale_20260930T044527Z.tif.

H61U-H1 pooled HOLDOUT-DTI was 0.0413507559 (95% CI 0.0353324448–0.0481004262; 12,074 withheld positives; evaluator gems61-pooled-hide-v2), versus unfiltered HGM maxima 0.0443593581 (95% CI 0.0368469195–0.0517639813). The paired H1-minus-HGM delta was -0.0030086022 (95% CI -0.0101048834–0.0049512141); no demonstrated gain over the strongest comparable control.
The single preregistered experiment is complete. H61U-H2/H3 remain unauthorized prospective alternatives; no post-hoc substitution or tuning was performed.
